role: Final pre-commit architecture/accounting and scanner guards; actual committed README comparison runs separately after commit
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
./scripts/check-task-plan.sh
./scripts/check-module-boundaries.sh
./scripts/check-lila-identity.sh
./scripts/check-no-legacy-js.sh
./scripts/check-test262-host-abi.sh
./scripts/check-no-interpreter-in-product-graph.sh
python3 -B scripts/generate-shortcut-status.py --check
./scripts/audit-test262-shortcuts.sh --check
rustc --edition=2021 -D warnings --test scripts/audit-test262-shortcuts.rs -o target/continuation-cloud-20261009/final-shortcut-scanner-unit
target/continuation-cloud-20261009/final-shortcut-scanner-unit --test-threads=1
./scripts/tests/audit-test262-shortcut-scanner.sh

./scripts/tests/check-readme-status-artifacts.sh
